B21D.fTerm:
WORKING OR PROCESSING OF SHEET METAL OR METAL TUBES, RODS OR PROFILES WITHOUT ESSENTIALLY REMOVING MATERIAL; PUNCHING METAL (working or processing of wire B21F)

Note(s)

  • This subclass covers cutting or perforating of sheet metal or other stock material.
  • This subclass does not cover the working of metal foils in a manner analogous to the working of paper, which is covered by classes B26, B31.
